entries.title: Proverbs 20:1
segments: ¶Wine [is] a mocker, Strong drink [is] a brawler, And whoever is led astray by it is not wise.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:2
segments: ¶The wrath of a king [is] like the roaring of a lion; [Whoever] provokes him to anger sins [against] his own life.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:3
segments: ¶[It is] honorable for a man to stop striving, Since any fool can start a quarrel.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:4
segments: ¶The lazy [man] will not plow because of winter; He will beg during harvest and [have] nothing.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:5
segments: ¶Counsel in the heart of man [is like] deep water, But a man of understanding will draw it out.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:6
segments: ¶Most men will proclaim each his own goodness, But who can find a faithful man?

entries.title: Proverbs 20:7
segments: ¶The righteous [man] walks in his integrity; His children [are] blessed after him.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:8
segments: ¶A king who sits on the throne of judgment Scatters all evil with his eyes.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:9
segments: ¶Who can say, "I have made my heart clean, I am pure from my sin"?

entries.title: Proverbs 20:10
segments: ¶Diverse weights [and] diverse measures, They [are] both alike, an abomination to the LORD.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:11
segments: ¶Even a child is known by his deeds, Whether what he does [is] pure and right.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:12
segments: ¶The hearing ear and the seeing eye, The LORD has made them both.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:13
segments: ¶Do not love sleep, lest you come to poverty; Open your eyes, [and] you will be satisfied with bread.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:14
segments: ¶"[It is] good for nothing," cries the buyer; But when he has gone his way, then he boasts.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:15
segments: ¶There is gold and a multitude of rubies, But the lips of knowledge [are] a precious jewel.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:16
segments: ¶Take the garment of one who is surety [for] a stranger, And hold it as a pledge [when it] is for a seductress.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:17
segments: ¶Bread gained by deceit [is] sweet to a man, But afterward his mouth will be filled with gravel.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:18
segments: ¶Plans are established by counsel; By wise counsel wage war.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:19
segments: ¶He who goes about [as] a talebearer reveals secrets; Therefore do not associate with one who flatters with his lips.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:20
segments: ¶Whoever curses his father or his mother, His lamp will be put out in deep darkness.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:21
segments: ¶An inheritance gained hastily at the beginning Will not be blessed at the end.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:22
segments: ¶Do not say, "I will recompense evil"; Wait for the LORD, and He will save you.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:23
segments: ¶Diverse weights [are] an abomination to the LORD, And dishonest scales [are] not good.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:24
segments: ¶A man's steps [are] of the LORD; How then can a man understand his own way?

entries.title: Proverbs 20:25
segments: ¶[It is] a snare for a man to devote rashly [something as] holy, And afterward to reconsider [his] vows.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:26
segments: ¶A wise king sifts out the wicked, And brings the threshing wheel over them.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:27
segments: ¶The spirit of a man [is] the lamp of the LORD, Searching all the inner depths of his heart.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:28
segments: ¶Mercy and truth preserve the king, And by lovingkindness he upholds his throne.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:29
segments: ¶The glory of young men [is] their strength, And the splendor of old men [is] their gray head.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:30
segments: ¶Blows that hurt cleanse away evil, As [do] stripes the inner depths of the heart.
